name: IC Analog Op-Amp — 55V — SOIC
description: Cluster of 55V analog operational amplifier ICs in surface-mount SOIC packages, featuring SOIC-8 and SOIC-14 footprints.
selection_hints: Select SOIC-8 (3.9x4.9mm) or SOIC-14 (3.9x8.7mm) footprints depending on application layout.
Choose between ADA4522 series variants (ADA4522-1, ADA4522-2, ADA4522-4, ADA4522-4ARZ) based on package footprint.
Verify source library selection between KiCad Symbols and Alternate KiCad Library.
avoid_when: The layout requires package families other than surface-mount SOIC.
The application requires an operating voltage rating other than 55V.
Footprint pitch or dimensions differ from SOIC-8 (3.9x4.9mm) or SOIC-14 (3.9x8.7mm) at 1.27mm pitch.
